description: Fixed evaluation surface for the Magic code-policy family. The five train opponents are visible in the workspace and are the agent's feedback signal only. The heldout split is sealed: this file publishes its shape and its digest, never its composition.

submission.note: Deck and pilot are graded together. A strong pilot cannot rescue an incoherent deck and a tuned deck cannot rescue a pilot that never attacks, so grading either alone measures the wrong thing.

reference.note: A named freeze of archetypes::v5, carrying v2 whole-set attack planning, v3 valued blocking, v4 land sequencing, and v5 activated abilities. The reference arm always plays this deck with this pilot; the candidate arm plays whatever the candidate submitted. That asymmetry is deliberate: this is a deck-and-pilot task, so the candidate's deck choice has to be part of what the delta measures.

train.pairing: cell = (candidate deck, candidate pilot, opponent, opponent deck, seat, seed). The candidate arm and the reference arm join on (opponent, opponent deck, seat, seed), which is the only coordinate they share.
train.note: Spans the v1..v5 generations on the constructed control decks, so the frozen reference sits inside a measurable range rather than beating or losing to everything.

heldout.provenance_note: Heldout opponents are (archetype-pilot generation, deck fixture) pairs drawn from generations and deck fixtures that are themselves present in this public repository. The seal therefore covers the *composition* of the split - which pilot flies which deck, in what order, over which seats and seeds - and not the secrecy of any individual source file. Receipts must say so and must not claim source-level secrecy. Disjoint from train by construction: no pilot generation and no deck fixture appears in both splits.

gate: paired bootstrap over per-cell score deltas; lower bound of the 95% interval strictly above zero AND no significant per-opponent regression
fail_closed: A sweep that does not reproduce this roster's cell set exactly - a missing cell, an extra cell, an unpaired cell, or a stall rate above 25% on either arm - scores zero rather than reporting the mean of the cells it managed to run.
